newsitem.title: USA: El Paso police to reward good drivers.
newsitem.headline: El Paso police to reward good drivers.

text.p: Traffic police in this Texas city said on Wednesday they would start pulling drivers over for obeying the law.
But, instead of issuing summons to traffic court, the police plan to reward good drivers with free coupons for goods ranging from fast-food meals to tickets for an ice skating ballet show.
El Paso police said the city's new programme, which is labeled "Operation Caught in the Act," is aimed at boosting the public image of traffic cops.

"Frequently, the only experience people have with cops is a bad one and a costly one," police spokesman Bill Pfeil said. "But take firemen; everyone loves firemen. They save your life, they save you money. Maybe we, too, can get a better image."
The good-driver stops are scheduled to start next week and last for a month but Pfeil said the programme could become a permanent fixture, depending on the public's response.
